changes.value: validate the job inputs before launch (required columns, file kind) and fail fast with an actionable message

hypothesis: Validating required columns and file kind before launch, with a fail-fast actionable message, will stop the observed missing-column failures from recurring without changing valid featurization outcomes.
risk: The preflight validation could reject otherwise valid jobs if its column or file-kind rules are stricter than the downstream featurization contract, so acceptance must confirm equivalence and zero replay failures.
